Workflow passed local pre-flight validation. NOT submitted (dry_run) — no GPU run, no credits spent, no job created. Re-call without dry_run to actually submit. Local validation uses a bundled node catalog that can lag the cloud, so this is a strong signal, not a guarantee.
Advisory (non-blocking) - the following input value(s) are valid but INERT: a sibling preset gates them, so the run will ignore them unless that gate is set to "Custom". Set the gate and resubmit, or drop the value:
Node #10: `model.custom_height`, `model.custom_width` take effect only when `model.size` is "Custom" — current value "1024x1024" means the run will use the preset size and ignore them. Set `model.size` to "Custom" to honour them, or drop them.
Note - This workflow includes paid partner-API node(s): Node #10: OpenAIGPTImageNodeV2 — running it will incur partner-API charges on the user's account.
